CustomField.description: The 18-character content ID followed by the voter's email address in lower case, up to 98 characters. Required and unique, so the database refuses a second vote by one person on one content record, whether they asked or voted. A validation rule rejects any other key. Writers look the key up before inserting and treat a duplicate-key refusal as already counted (ADR 0003).
CustomField.label: Voter Key
